description: Contract for the gate2-admission-canary dry run. Unlike the read-only rehearsal contract, this one admits the operations a Gate 2 producer actually needs -- read the code, change it, run the one allowed test command, inspect the diff, emit a result artifact -- and nothing else. There is deliberately no verb that runs an arbitrary command, no verb that reaches the network, and no verb that can write outside the workspace repo.

read.summary: print one file from the workspace repo

write.summary: replace one file in the workspace repo with base64-encoded content; the container reports back the resulting sha256

test.summary: run the one allowed test command (python -m unittest discover)

report.summary: write the result artifact to the workspace out directory from base64-encoded content
